comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks an existing gripper opening stop; PR-2243 removes a failed gas strut, installs a replacement, and checks the lid’s operation.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate centers two tools on a coupled screw/nut assembly and counterholds tightening reaction without shifting the setting. PR-2243 manipulates spring clips and ball sockets while supporting a hinged lid, then seats and retention-tests the replacement strut.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires target-angle accuracy, seated/retained nuts, three repeatable cycles, bounded drift, and hands-off clearance. PR-2243 requires removal and safe placement of the failed strut, correct two-end installation, lid hold-open and closure events, plus socket pull and lift tests.
comparison.reason: Although both are bimanual maintenance tasks with functional verification, PR-2243 tests clip release, socket insertion, component replacement, and load support rather than countertorque-based calibration retention. Both available spec versions were read and provide complete numeric rubrics; no material rubric detail is missing.
